metadata.title: High-Contrast Grainy Portrait with Neon Script

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, grainy black-and-white close-up portrait oriented diagonally, featuring a stark black border at the top containing white slab-serif text, and a secondary teal script title with a drop shadow placed in the upper right negative space.
coreVisualRelationships: Diagonal tilt of the subject creates dynamic tension against the horizontal top bar.
Extreme stipple grain texture bridges the transition between deep blacks and bright whites.
Teal script provides a vibrant color pop against the monochromatic background.
coreInvariants: Heavy stipple/film grain texture throughout the image.
Black header bar spanning the full width at the top.
High-contrast lighting that obscures details into solid black shapes.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up of a face, tilted approximately 45 degrees, filling the left and bottom two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eye in the center-left, which is the only sharp point of focus amidst the grain.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top black bar, follows the diagonal line of the face down to the bottom left, then jumps to the teal script in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Concentrated in the upper right quadrant, providing a canvas for the secondary typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black and White (Monochrome portrait and header bar)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in the image; high saturation contrast between the monochrome base and the teal accent.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric slab serif and expressive brush script
letterConstructionRules: Top text uses heavy, blocky slabs with wide tracking.
Script text uses a 30-degree upward slant with fluid, connected strokes.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Script 'H' and 'L' feature elongated descenders and ascenders.
Slab serif 'A' has a wide stance.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between rigid, architectural slab serifs and fluid, organic brush script.

preserve: Wide tracking of the top text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif weight and blunt terminals of the header.
Captures the 80s-style casual brush stroke and slant.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, black and white close-up portrait of a face tilted at a 45-degree angle. Apply a heavy stipple grain or mezzotint effect so the midtones are made of distinct black dots. Include a solid black horizontal bar at the very top of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add white uppercase slab-serif text inside the top black bar with extremely wide letter spacing. In the upper right negative space, add a three-line staggered teal brush script title tilted upwards, featuring a dark blue hard drop shadow.

verificationChecks: Is the grain texture prominent in the midtones?
Is the top text white on a black background?
Is the script text teal with a dark shadow?

adjustableVariables: Width of the top black bar
mustRedesign: Specific facial features to avoid likeness

mustAchieve: Vibrant, saturated accent color for the script

postGenerationChecks: Check that the grain does not look like digital noise but like physical stippling.
Ensure the teal script is legible against the grainy background.
Verify the slab serif text is perfectly horizontal within the black bar.
Confirm the diagonal composition creates a sense of movement.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast stipple portrait + horizontal header bar + diagonal script overlay.
